lastCompletedStory.title: Record the passFloor-headroom convention in patterns.md

nextStoryContext: Appended one bullet to the end of scripts/cam/patterns.md (never truncated, never reordered existing bullets) recording the passFloor-headroom convention as a living rule, not a one-time mechanic (no '[resolved YYYY-MM]' marker per the story notes). The bullet states passFloor must never be maintained at equality with the current pass count; names the enforcing mechanism (MIN_PASS_FLOOR_HEADROOM in scripts/check-skip-ratchet.ts, from US-001) and its applicability guard (a recorded floor of 0 means 'no floor declared' and is exempt); records the deliberate contrast with expectedSkips (kept exactly equal on purpose, since detecting skip drift in either direction is the ratchet's whole point); and cites the historical evidence using the exact phrase 'four measured invalidations' (US-006 wrote 5720, US-R1-002 added 11 and staled it, US-R2-001 corrected to 5731, US-R2-002 added 3 and staled it again, then CAM-448 added 27 across PRDs and staled it a fourth time) -- these are historical counts with dates attached (the one legitimate use of a past count per the story notes), not live comparands, and no oracle greps for a live count. All 3 content oracles (grep -q 'never be maintained at equality', grep -q 'MIN_PASS_FLOOR_HEADROOM' && grep -q 'no floor declared', grep -q 'four measured invalidations' && grep -q 'expectedSkips') were run directly against the file after the edit and all exited 0. patterns.md is a .md file, not covered by scripts/check-file-sizes.ts's glob ({src,scripts,test}/**/*.{ts,tsx} only -- confirmed by reading the script), so no file-size-budget.json raise was needed despite the story notes flagging it as a possible expected step; this was verified by inspection of check-file-sizes.ts's makeDefaultGetSizes, not assumed. `bun run typecheck` (0 errors), `bun test` (5761 pass / 0 fail, host lane, unchanged from US-002), and the full `bun run check:all` spine (typecheck, test, embed-vendor, lint, file-size, debt-markers, version-skips, coverage, dead-code, dup, ci-parity, agents-md, test-sleeps, skip-ratchet -- host lane '0 skip (matches recorded expectation)') are all green. No source code or external library was touched (pure patterns.md documentation append), so Step 5.5 is a no-op for this story, same as US-001/US-002.
